title: Bitter Heaven
description:
Shizuka's favorite thing in the world is coffee--caffeinated coffee to be exact.
But one day all the coffee in that world became decaf.
One man seems to be responsible.
With her giant spoon in hand and definitely non-lethal firearm, Shizuka with her friend by her side, seeks answers.

Key Features
Cute retro world with many challenges, power-ups, and secrets to discover

Fast-paced, bullet-hell bosses

4 difficulties for hardcores and amateurs alike

Bonus challenge rooms

Traditional hand-drawn character art and illustrations in dialogue scenes.

Cute chibi girls 

Changeable outfits

Post game content

EPILEPSY WARNING - This game contains many flashing images. Play at your own risk
description_short: Survive intense bullet-hell bosses. Shoot enemies in the face. Discover the worlds many secrets. Break things with a giant---spoon?
